biggest_catch: Small payouts with a drip schedule: only $10 per referral and only ONE $10 credit posts per month (extras queue to later months) — and the whole program ENDS December 31, 2026, after which no new referrals are accepted.
catches: Referral credits are limited to $10 per month and do NOT stack — multiple credits are applied $10/month until exhausted.
Credit is applied to the referrer's bill only after the friend's installation is completed; credits may take up to two billing cycles to appear.
The referral card/code must be presented when the referred person signs up — no retroactive credit.
Program ends December 31, 2026; no new referrals accepted after that date (earned credits still honored).
Must be a PES Energize subscriber (residential or business) in Giles County, Tennessee; this is a small municipal utility, not available elsewhere.
Framing: bill credits reduce future energy/internet bills — savings on planned spending, not income.

steps: Get your unique referral code: visit the PES Energize office or fill out the referral form (Mon-Fri, 8am-4pm).
Share the referral card/code with friends, family, or neighbors.
The referred person presents your referral card when they sign up for PES Energize service.
After their installation is completed, you receive a $10 bill credit and they receive a $10 bill credit (may take up to two billing cycles).
Credits apply at $10/month — refer more people for more months of $10 credits.
timing: Credits applied after the friend's installation is completed; may take up to two billing cycles to appear; capped at $10/month applied. Program ends 12/31/2026.
